function takeNumber(a: number, b: number) {}
function generic<T>(a: number, b: T) {}
function takeText(a: string, b: number) {}
let plain: string | number = "text";
takeNumber(plain, plain = 1);
let inferred: string | number = "text";
generic(inferred, inferred = 2);
let immediate: string | number = "text";
((a: number, b: number) => a.toFixed())(immediate, immediate = 3);
let spread: string | number = "text";
takeText(spread.toFixed(), ...([spread = 4] as [number]));
let deleted: { p?: number } | string;
let deleteSelector: { p?: number } | string = { p: 1 };
delete (deleted = deleteSelector)[deleteSelector = "p"];
deleted.toUpperCase();
let receiver: { m(): void } | string;
let selected: { m(): void } | string = { m() {} };
(receiver = selected)[selected = "m"]();
receiver.toUpperCase();
let body: string | number = "text";
((ignored) => { body = 0; })(body = "new");
body.toUpperCase();
let spreadState: string | number = "before";
((first, second) => second.toUpperCase())(...([spreadState = 3] as [number]), spreadState);
